crew.overview: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD blade runner who has been missing for 30 years.
crew.title: Blade Runner 2049

crew.overview: Garfield, the world-famous, Monday-hating, lasagna-loving indoor cat, is about to have a wild outdoor adventure! After an unexpected reunion with his long-lost father – scruffy street cat Vic – Garfield and his canine friend Odie are forced from their perfectly pampered life into joining Vic in a hilarious, high-stakes heist.
crew.title: The Garfield Movie

details.biography: Rachel Amanda Alterman is a production assistant. She graduated from the American Film Institute Conservatory with an MFA in Producing.
details.name: Rachel Amanda Alterman
